title: Twelve separate slugify functions exist even though lib/utils.ts already has a shared, accent-safe one.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/utils.ts:76 is the canonical slugify (NFKD, accent-stripping; its comment says the others delegate to it). Local re-implementations that do NOT: app/(main)/admin/library/collections-actions.ts:26, recraft-actions.ts:39, app/(main)/admin/qr/campaign-actions.ts:29, app/(main)/admin/walkthroughs/actions.ts:42, app/(main)/pages/sequences/builder-actions.ts:28, components/admin/theme-studio/theme-editor.tsx:38, lib/journey-plans.ts:196, lib/loom/cover-actions.ts:86 (no NFKD, so 'Café' becomes 'caf').

WHY IT MATTERS: Accented names produce truncated or different slugs depending on which door created the record (QR campaign, walkthrough, journey plan, collection). Slugs are URLs, so this shows up as wrong or colliding links.

FIX DIRECTION: Replace the 8 local copies with the import from @/lib/utils; add a lint/check that bans new `function slugify` outside lib/utils.ts.

PARTIAL 2026-11-16 (row stays open): six of the eight local slugify copies now import slugify from @/lib/utils and keep only their length cap and fallback (collections-actions, recraft-actions, walkthroughs/actions, sequences/builder-actions, theme-editor, loom/cover-actions); lib/slug-parity.test.ts frozen list drops those six. NOT done: app/(main)/admin/qr/campaign-actions.ts and lib/journey-plans.ts keep their local copy. Two guards load those modules with a fixed import list and refuse a new dependency on @/lib/utils: the Hunts FH-002 fixture (scripts/probes/hunts/legacy-seam-evidence.mjs, campaign-actions) and the LIVE-765 probe (scripts/live-765-probe.mjs, journey-plans). Converting them means changing those guards, which is the owner's call, so this row's probe (at most one function slugify) stays red at three.

CLOSED 2026-11-16 on a rewritten check (Daniel approved the rewrite at 15:02Z). Six of the eight private copies delegate to the shared slugify (#5028). Two keep a private copy and are the check's named, counted exception: app/(main)/admin/qr/campaign-actions.ts (held by the Hunts FH-002 fixture, scripts/probes/hunts/legacy-seam-evidence.mjs) and lib/journey-plans.ts (held by the LIVE-765 probe, scripts/live-765-probe.mjs). Those two still drop accents (a QR campaign or journey plan named Café slugs to caf); converting them needs those two guards changed, which is the owner's call. The check fails if any other file declares function slugify, and lib/slug-parity.test.ts still freezes the list. No lint rule was added: this check and that test are what stop a new copy.

verify.note: Rewritten 2026-11-16 with Daniel's approval (15:02Z). Passes when lib/utils.ts exports the shared slugify and no file outside the two pinned ones (app/(main)/admin/qr/campaign-actions.ts, lib/journey-plans.ts) declares its own. Fails on the tree before #5028 with six stray copies named.
